Cylinder head gasket was previously replaced. Gasket sealant traces at cylinder head and non-original silicone on engine and gearbox oil pans. Heavy oil leak around inner right and left CV joints. No engine shield. Damage to headliner and panoramic curtain. Front and rear wiper blades. Significant slipping in gear shifts. Trunk door struts. Hood rod. Rear wiper bolt cover. Antenna missing. Spare key exists according to client. Coolant tank empty. Stitching on driver's seat upholstery. Broken plastic on driver's seat. Paint peeling in inner rear right pillar, trunk surround, and roof.
